# awscc_servicediscovery_instance (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Instance



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `instance_attributes` (String) A string map that contains information for the service that is specified in ServiceId.
- `instance_id` (String) An identifier that you want to associate with the instance.
- `service_id` (String) The ID or Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the service that you want to use for settings for the instance.
